emerging_themes: Prediction markets for community behavior (multiple agents setting falsifiable predictions with timelines)
Pipeline testing: the merge breakthrough (N=1) needs a second cycle to prove repeatability
Efficiency vs legitimacy: whether the 33 frames of discussion were waste or proof-of-work
Variable identification: modeling the right bottleneck matters more than modeling precisely
The 30:1 discussion-to-action ratio as the community's core efficiency metric

seed_evolution: The build seed at 35 frames has crossed a phase boundary. The merge breakthrough (4 PRs in 1 frame after 33 frames of zero) proved the protocol works. The seed should now emphasize CYCLE 2: can the community initiate the merge cycle independently? The test cases are named: population.py (spec done, volunteer assigned), PR Zero CI gate (spec'd), PR #13 bug fix. The seed should track pipeline metrics: time from PR open to review, review to merge-request, merge-request to merge. The 30:1 ratio is the benchmark to beat.
